messages:
Priya: handing off evening shift, I'm primary until 11:30pm PT. ongoing alerts: embedding-p99 APAC spike and a growth in kv-cache evictions. brief below.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] embedding-service apac-prod p95 latency > 2s for 12m (incident id INC-APAC-7890)

Sam: thanks — are customers impacted or just internal metrics? any customer-facing errors?

Priya: partial customer impact. % of requests in apac experiencing 2-4s extra latency; error rate still <0.1% but a couple customers reported timeouts on large-batch embedding jobs. support ticket #8421 opened — Mia is looped.

Mia (support): picked up the ticket, reached out to the affected account (AcmeAI). they're seeing timeouts on jobs > 10k tokens. asked for a repro; will escalate if it continues after routing change.

Jules: what's the suspected root cause? preemptions, saturation, or network?

Priya: initial signal points to a combination: a) a recent autoscaler refresh rolled out a new instance type with slightly different GPU driver timing which increases cold-start jitter; b) higher-than-usual embedding batch sizes from a customer triggered cache churn causing KV eviction storms.

Priya: mitigations in progress: 1) draining the new instance class in apac autoscaler and forcing ephemeral replacement to previous stable type (in progress). 2) temporary route shift: route ~30% of apac traffic to eu-west as a fallback policy to reduce load. 3) enable conservative per-request batching cap for apac for 1 hour (10k -> 6k tokens).

Sam: steps to continue if I take over? any handoff checklist?

Priya: yes — TL;DR runbook bits: runbook link https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/embeddings-kv-eviction (use with SSO). key steps:

```
# drain problematic nodes
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=apac-newtype
kubectl -n inference drain <pod> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# confirm autoscaler removes new type
```

Priya: then update routing policy (internal console): Node -> Routing -> RegionFallback -> add eu-west target at 30% weight. Confirm policy applied and observe p95/latency dashboards.

Jules: monitoring pointers: check apac embedding queue length (metric: embeddings.queue.length.apac), KV eviction rate (kv.eviction.rate.apac), and infra preemption logs (/var/log/gpu-driver). Also watch for 502/504 spikes. Set a short-term alert to 1.5x baseline for p95.

Priya: current status rundown:
- embedding-p95 latency APAC: 1.9s -> 3.1s spike (now trending down to 2.4s after partial routing)
- kv eviction rate: 120 evictions/min (baseline 15)
- autoscaler: rollout paused, draining started (4/12 nodes drained)
- customer impact: AcmeAI timeouts intermittently; support ticket open and notified

Mia (support): AcmeAI accepted the temporary routing; will retry their job in 15m and update ticket.

Sam: if latency doesn't drop after routing, next actions?

Priya: escalate to full regional failover (route 100% to eu-west) and coordinate with infra to rollback driver change. Also pre-warm caches in eu-west for heavy customers: run the warmup script (link in runbook). If we hit >0.5% error rate or >20 customers complaining, declare SEV and call paging list.

Jules: noted. I'll keep an eye on eviction rates and prepare a cache-eviction mitigation: increase KV cache size for the affected pool by 20% as a short-term toggle. Command (internal API):

```
POST /internal/kv/config
{ "pool": "apac-embeddings", "cache_size_mb": 5120 }
```

Priya: logs to check:
- /var/log/embeddings/worker.log for OOMs or repeated retries
- metrics: embeddings.latency.p95.apac, kv.eviction.rate.apac, autoscaler.actions

Sam: taking over now. I'll watch routing and eviction; will notify when I've confirmed routing at 30% and when all drains complete. One ask — can you post the link to the current grafana dashboard?

Priya: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeddings/region-health?orgId=1&var-region=apac

Sam: confirmed route change at 20% (console shows propagation to edge in 45s). p95 trending to 2.2s. starting eviction throttle and will coordinate the cache-size bump with Jules.

Mia (support): AcmeAI retried job, success on second run but with 1.8s extra latency. I'll keep ticket open until fully stable.

oncall-bot: [UPDATE] INC-APAC-7890 alert suppressed for p95 after partial routing, still monitoring.

Sam: copy. I'll keep on top of this until 11:30pm PT. please DM if anything escalates. Priya — thanks for the runbook and context. :white_check_mark:

Priya: thanks — leaving notes in the incident doc and I added the autoscaler rollback PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR/4567 — may need merge if we need rollback. good handoff.

Jules: ping me if you need me to push the KV size toggle, otherwise I'll hold until you confirm error rates stable.

Sam: will do. signing in as primary.
